summary: ACOINVEST AS (org. no. 831 059 532) is a private limited company (AS) based in Drammen, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2023-03-20. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 33.130 (Reparasjon og vedlikehold av elektronisk og optisk utstyr); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was NOK 359 071. CEO: Trond Abelsen; board chair: Trond Abelsen.
